title: REDI-NET F-2 Feces Processing
author: REDI-NET Consortium
materials: Select the program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash on the instrument.
Select the program IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash on the instrument.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Bead Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare bead tubes with buffer and fecal samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL of ASL buffer to the bead tubes (prepared per 'Before Start' guidelines).

Weigh approximately 100 mg of fecal sample (roughly 5 drops of mouse feces) using a clean spatula or forceps and place into each prepared bead tube. If frozen, thaw and keep on ice. Record the weight.

steps.title: Prepare Controls
steps.instruction: Include positive and negative controls for each batch of samples.

substeps.instruction: Positive Control: Transfer 37.5 µL ZymoBIOMICS Microbial Community Standard Material, 100 µL EBV, and 100 µL DENV-1 standard into a bead tube, then add 250 µL ASL buffer.
Negative Control: Use a bead tube with 500 µL ASL buffer only.

steps.title: Perform Initial Beating
steps.instruction: Homogenize samples using the Bullet Blender.

substeps.instruction: Refill the dry ice compartment of the Bullet Blender if necessary.
Load all samples into the Bullet Blender.
Set speed to 12 and time to 3, then press Start.

steps.title: Incubate and Repeat Beating
steps.instruction: Heat samples and perform a second round of beating.

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples at 95 °C for 15 minutes.
Beat samples in the Bullet Blender (refill dry ice if necessary) at speed 12 and time 3.
Let samples settle for 1 minute in the Bullet Blender, then repeat the beating step (speed 12, time 3).

steps.title: Centrifuge and Store Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the bead tubes containing lysate at 12,000 x g and 4 °C for 5 minutes. Lysed samples can be stored at 4 °C overnight as a stopping point.

steps.title: Configure KingFisher Instrument
steps.instruction: Set up the KingFisher instrument based on the model being used.

substeps.instruction: For KingFisher Flex: Confirm 96 deep-well magnetic heads and 96 well deep-well heat blocks are used. Ensure program 'IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Flex_4wash' is loaded.
For KingFisher Duo Prime: Confirm 12-tip magnetic heads and 12 well deep-well heat blocks are used. Ensure program 'IndiMag_Pathogen_KF_Duo_4wash' is loaded.

steps.title: Prepare Plates and Reagents
steps.instruction: Set up the plates and prepare the sample mixture. Note: Do not use the kit's elution buffer for TNA elution as it inhibits DNA sequencing efficiency.

substeps.instruction: Set up plates according to the instrument model: For Flex, use the 96-well table (Tip comb: 96 Deep-well; Elution: 75 µL Nuclease-free water; Wash 4: 750 µL 100% ethanol; Wash 3: 750 µL 80% ethanol; Wash 2: 700 µL Buffer AW2; Wash 1: 700 µL Buffer AW1). For Duo Prime, use the Row A-F table (Row A: Sample; Row B: Buffer AW1 700 µL; Row C: Buffer AW2 700 µL; Row D: 80% ethanol 750 µL; Row E: 100% ethanol 750 µL; Row F: Tip comb; Elution Strip Row A: 75 µL Nuclease-free water).
Add 20 µL of Proteinase K into the sample wells (Flex deep-well plate or Duo Prime Row A).
Transfer 270 µL of supernatant without particle carryover to the wells containing Proteinase K.

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix
steps.instruction: Add lysis and binding reagents to the sample plate.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a master mix (with 10% overage for multiple samples) containing 135 µL Buffer VXL, 540 µL Buffer ACB, and 20 µL MagAttract Suspension G per sample.
Invert slowly to mix or use a Hula mixer for 2 minutes; avoid foaming.
Add 695 µL of the mixture to each sample. The final volume per well should be 985 µL.
Start the run and load plates/strips into position when prompted.
For Duo Prime: Keep the door open during extraction to prevent ethanol vapor restraint and contamination.
After the run (~35 minutes), immediately remove the elution plate, cover it, or transfer eluate to final storage tubes.

steps.title: Quantify Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Measure DNA and RNA concentrations using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer with Qubit 1X dsDNA HS and RNA HS Assay Kits.

substeps.instruction: Use 1 µL of total nucleic acid in a 0.6 mL microcentrifuge tube. If concentration is too high, dilute 2 µL of sample with 18 µL nuclease-free water and use 3 µL of the dilution.
For DNA: Add 1x HS dsDNA Qubit Assay to a final volume of 200 µL (e.g., 199 µL assay + 1 µL sample). Vortex 5-10 seconds, incubate 2 minutes at room temperature, and read.

For RNA: Prepare a working solution of 199 µL Qubit RNA HS Assay buffer and 1 µL Qubit RNA HS Assay Dye per sample. Mix 199 µL of this working solution with 1 µL of sample in a 0.6 mL tube. Vortex 5-10 seconds, incubate 2 minutes at room temperature, and read.

steps.title: Store or Test Samples
steps.instruction: Proceed to testing or store the samples.

substeps.instruction: Test following REDI-NET SOP F-4 Fecal Testing.
Short-term storage: -20 °C for less than 2 weeks.
Long-term storage: -80 °C following REDI-NET SOP F-3 Fecal Storage.
